name: Old and New Towns of Edinburgh
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: In Scotland's southeast, near the Firth of Forth, Edinburgh pairs two contrasting historic districts. The medieval Old Town huddles beneath Edinburgh Castle, with St Giles' Cathedral and the Palace of Holyroodhouse nearby. Just across the valley, the orderly Georgian New Town, begun in the 18th century, spreads out in neoclassical streets that influenced city planning across Europe.
